_README: Integrity manifest for the Demucs model weights. doctor.sh validates the ACTIVE model only (companion_app/companion_profile.json -> "model"), so switching htdemucs <-> htdemucs_ft never false-alarms on the other model's files. Each model is a torch-hub download in ~/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints/; the filename suffix is demucs's own truncated-sha256 checksum. If any file is missing, truncated, or corrupted, /v1/stems/split fails and isolation breaks. demucs re-downloads with no user-visible progress and a partial download can silently corrupt a file, so doctor.sh checks size (+ sha256 with --deep) up front instead of mid-session. htdemucs = single-file model (~80 MB, fast, real-time live-isolation default). htdemucs_ft = bag of 4 fine-tuned sub-models (~320 MB, ~4x slower, slightly cleaner offline path).
